population.boundary_rule: Native cells whose centres fall inside polygon; no fractional-cell redistribution
population.dataset: WorldPop 2020 aggregated 1 km UN-adjusted population counts

facilities.coverage: Incomplete OSM inventory, not official complete list; node/way duplicates across types or nearby entrances not merged without evidence. Assembly points are not designated shelters.

rainfall.name: BAOAN INTERNATIONAL

event_daily_records.resolution: daily report; accumulation may include previous day
daily report; accumulation may include previous day

rainfall.time_note: GMT nominal report dates, may include previous day; no hourly/15-minute disaggregation

flood.confidence_note: Geometric association only. No point is an observed flood event; selection never declares road flooded.

limitations: No official historical georeferenced flood points or road depth monitoring acquired
Copernicus GLO-30 is DSM, not bare-earth drainage DTM; no hydraulic calibration
WorldPop 2020 UN-adjusted ~1 km modelled counts, not 2023/2026 census or daytime traffic demand
Native population cells use centre-in-polygon inclusion, with boundary and coastal uncertainty
OSM POIs incomplete; polygon points and road candidates are not verified facility entrances
OSM assembly points are separate from designated emergency shelters
Airport daily rainfall outside Nanshan is regional context, not local areal or 15-minute input
